_note: Bars for tests/run_motion_tests.gd, the motion gate (D-177 'Motion first'). Every number was measured on origin/main 1f23937a (walk, 90/180 turns, turn from standing, held curve, 6 s each, seeded sim, 60 Hz) and set a small margin past the measured value; never widen a bar to get green, fix the motion. slide_max (units/s) and aloft_yaw_max (deg): measured 0.00 at every stage, bars sit just above zero. catch_straight: catch steps a second walking straight, measured 0, one step in the 5 s window is 0.2. catch_turn_smooth: the young croc's smooth turns (D-131), measured worst 1.00 (turn180), bar held at the 2026-10-23 lead ruling. steps_ratio_min/max: legs steps a second over the walk clip's authored pace, measured young 2.26, Behemoth 2.15, Colossus 1.75, bar about +-8%. step_tol: the sim's step vs half the clip's stride, measured 0.0% Behemoth, 0.2% Colossus. jerk_walk/jerk_turn: shin jerk p99 in deg/frame^2, measured walk 2.7/4.3/1.0, worst turn 4.83/6.95/5.36 (young/Behemoth/Colossus), bar about +15-20%. stretch_max: planted hip-ankle reach as a share of leg length, measured worst 0.93. pivot_max / centre_max: hip heights, measured worst 0.06 / 0.42. lift_min/lift_max: the walk clip's toe-tip rise as a share of hip height, measured 3.8% / 2.1% / 2.0%; the young croc may bounce a little (lead 2026-10-23), the lower bar says the feet do lift.

claw_arm._note: Bars for the claw swipe's raking arm (docs/claw_swipe_plan.md; tests/lib/claw_arm_probe.gd run by the croc standing suite, printed by tools/claw_probe.gd). body_scales: each stage's body scale in a run (Growth.body_scale at size 1, 2, 3); per-stage lists are young croc, Behemoth, Colossus. Measured on claude/claw-anim-525a2a after the young croc's arms were cut to 40% (director 2026-10-25) and the strike became a short chop in front of the chest: stretch 0.0% at every stage; elbow 19-41 / 24-69 / 23-57 deg; wrist max 0 (held straight, lock_wrist) / 47 / 47; upper arm least outward -0.42 / -0.31 / -0.35; fastest bone 621 / 641 / 643 deg/s; the chop takes 16 / 16 / 17 frames and is fastest on (or 1 frame after) the hit frame; the claw comes within 0.19 / 0.03 / 0.09 hip heights of the snout line (the young croc's short arm cannot reach it; aim capped by claw_fx.aim_max_deg); home by 1.50 s. Before (main cee43552): stretch +60% young, peaks ~8000 deg/s with a 120 deg one-frame flip, a 2-frame strike. Bars: stretch_max (share of rest length), elbow_min/max (deg; never locked straight or folded flat), wrist_max (deg per stage; the young croc's hand stays in line), across_min (the upper arm at most ~37 deg across the midline), peak_baby (deg/s, any arm bone, falling as 1/sqrt(body scale over the young croc's): bigger swings slower), contact_frames (the chop is fastest within this many frames of the sim's hit), chop_frames (frames the claw moves at 25% of its peak speed or more; lead 2026-10-25: 14-18 so the hand is seen travelling), short_max (hip heights per stage the claw may stay short of the snout line in the strike, D-190), home_s (back on its held pose before the next windup: powers.swipe_interval).
